notablePrerequisites:
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has at least 2 power.
Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
easyPrerequisites: Gilder Bairn does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Gilder Bairn's ability from Song of Freyalise by tapping it, adding {G/U}.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.
